"""
Navigate Bot Behaviors and Actions With CLI Tests - Status Display

Epic: Invoke Bot Through Panel
Sub-Epic: Navigate Behavior Action Status

These tests focus on status display functionality via CLI:
- Display Hierarchy (status command shows bot hierarchy)
- Display Current Position (status shows current behavior/action)

Uses common helpers from: test_invoke_bot_helpers.py
"""
import pytest
import sys
import json
from agile_bot.src.cli.cli_session import CLISession
from agile_bot.bots.base_bot.test.test_invoke_bot_helpers import (
    setup_test_bot,
    create_behavior_action_state,
)


class TestDisplayBotHierarchyTree:
    """
    Story: Display Bot Hierarchy Tree with Progress Indicators
    
    Epic: Invoke Bot Through Panel
    Sub-Epic: Navigate Behavior Action Status
    Story: Display Hierarchy
    
    CLI focus: Hierarchy tree display format with progress markers
    """
    
    def test_user_views_bot_hierarchy_with_status_command(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """
        SCENARIO: User views bot hierarchy with status command
        GIVEN: CLI is at exploration.validate
        WHEN: user enters 'status'
        THEN: CLI parses status command
              CLI displays bot hierarchy tree
        
        CLI focus: Status command execution and hierarchy display
        """
        # GIVEN
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: True)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape', 'exploration'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        # WHEN: user enters 'status' via CLI
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        cli_output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        # THEN: Status displayed
        assert cli_output is not None
        assert isinstance(cli_output, str)
        assert len(cli_output) > 0
        assert not cli_output.strip().startswith('{')  # Not JSON (TTY format)


class TestDisplayCurrentPosition:
    """
    Story: Display Current Position in CLI
    
    Epic: Invoke Bot Through Panel
    Sub-Epic: Navigate Behavior Action Status
    Story: Display Current Position
    
    CLI focus: Current position indicators in status display
    """
    
    def test_user_views_current_position_in_status(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """
        SCENARIO: User views current position in status
        GIVEN: CLI is at shape.clarify
        WHEN: user enters 'status'
        THEN: CLI displays current position with indicators
        
        CLI focus: Position display in status output
        """
        # GIVEN
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: True)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'shape', 'clarify')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        # WHEN: user enters 'status' via CLI
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        cli_output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        # THEN: Current position displayed
        assert cli_output is not None
        assert isinstance(cli_output, str)
        assert len(cli_output) > 0
        assert not cli_output.strip().startswith('{')  # Not JSON (TTY format)
    
    def test_cli_displays_progress_section_with_current_position(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """
        SCENARIO: CLI displays Progress section with current position
        GIVEN: CLI is at exploration.validate (piped mode)
        WHEN: CLI renders status display
        THEN: CLI displays Progress section header in JSON format
        
        CLI focus: Progress section in status display (JSON channel)
        """
        # GIVEN: Piped mode (JSON output)
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: False)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['exploration'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        # WHEN: Status displayed
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        json_output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        # THEN: Valid JSON format
        status_json = json.loads(json_output)
        assert 'progress_path' in status_json
        assert status_json['progress_path'] == 'exploration.validate'
        assert 'current_behavior' in status_json
        assert status_json['current_behavior'] == 'exploration'
        assert 'current_action' in status_json
        assert status_json['current_action'] == 'validate'
    
    def test_cli_displays_behavior_in_progress_section(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """
        SCENARIO: CLI displays behavior in Progress section
        GIVEN: CLI is at shape.validate (piped mode)
        WHEN: CLI renders status display
        THEN: CLI displays current behavior in Progress section
        
        CLI focus: Behavior display in progress section (JSON channel)
        """
        # GIVEN: Piped mode (JSON output)
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: False)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'shape', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        # WHEN: Status displayed
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        json_output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        # THEN: Valid JSON with behavior info
        status_json = json.loads(json_output)
        assert 'current_behavior' in status_json
        assert status_json['current_behavior'] == 'shape'
        assert 'current_action' in status_json
        assert status_json['current_action'] == 'validate'

```javascript
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const assert = require('assert');
const path = require('path');
const StatusView = require('../src/status/status_view');

describe('Epic: Invoke Bot Through Panel', () => {
    
    describe('Sub-Epic: Manage Bot Information', () => {
        
        describe('Story: Open Panel', () => {
            
            it('Scenario: Panel receives Status JSON from CLI subprocess', async () => {
                const mockStatusJSON = {
                    progress_path: 'exploration.validate',
                    stage_name: 'In Progress',
                    current_behavior: 'exploration',
                    current_action: 'validate',
                    has_current_behavior: true,
                    has_current_action: true
                };
                
                const statusView = new StatusView(mockStatusJSON, null);
                const html = statusView.render();
                
                assert(html.includes('exploration.validate'));
                assert(html.includes('In Progress'));
                assert(html.includes('exploration'));
                assert(html.includes('validate'));
            });
            
            it('Scenario: Panel displays status with no current action', () => {
                const idleStatusJSON = {
                    progress_path: 'idle',
                    stage_name: 'Idle',
                    current_behavior: null,
                    current_action: null,
                    has_current_behavior: false,
                    has_current_action: false
                };
                
                const statusView = new StatusView(idleStatusJSON, null);
                const html = statusView.render();
                
                assert(html.includes('idle'));
                assert(html.includes('Idle'));
                assert(!html.includes('null'));
                assert(!html.includes('undefined'));
            });
        });
        
        describe('Story: Refresh Panel', () => {
            
            it('Scenario: StatusView renders updated status after refresh', () => {
                const initialStatusJSON = {
                    progress_path: 'shape.clarify',
                    stage_name: 'In Progress',
                    current_behavior: 'shape',
                    current_action: 'clarify',
                    has_current_behavior: true,
                    has_current_action: true
                };
                
                const updatedStatusJSON = {
                    progress_path: 'shape.strategy',
                    stage_name: 'In Progress',
                    current_behavior: 'shape',
                    current_action: 'strategy',
                    has_current_behavior: true,
                    has_current_action: true
                };
                
                const statusView1 = new StatusView(initialStatusJSON, null);
                const html1 = statusView1.render();
                assert(html1.includes('shape.clarify'));
                
                const statusView2 = new StatusView(updatedStatusJSON, null);
                const html2 = statusView2.render();
                assert(html2.includes('shape.strategy'));
                assert(!html2.includes('shape.clarify'));
            });
        });
    });
    
    describe('Sub-Epic: Status View Rendering', () => {
        
        describe('Story: Render Status HTML', () => {
            
            it('Scenario: StatusView renders Status JSON to HTML', () => {
                const statusJSON = {
                    progress_path: 'shape.gather_context',
                    stage_name: 'In Progress',
                    current_behavior: 'shape',
                    current_action: 'gather_context',
                    has_current_behavior: true,
                    has_current_action: true
                };
                
                const statusView = new StatusView(statusJSON, null);
                const html = statusView.render();
                
                assert(html.includes('<div class="status-view">'));
                assert(html.includes('shape.gather_context'));
                assert(html.includes('In Progress'));
                assert(html.includes('shape'));
                assert(html.includes('gather_context'));
            });
            
            it('Scenario: StatusView handles missing current action gracefully', () => {
                const statusJSON = {
                    progress_path: 'idle',
                    stage_name: 'Idle',
                    current_behavior: null,
                    current_action: null,
                    has_current_behavior: false,
                    has_current_action: false
                };
                
                const statusView = new StatusView(statusJSON, null);
                const html = statusView.render();
                
                assert(html.includes('idle'));
                assert(html.includes('Idle'));
                assert(!html.includes('status-current') || !html.includes('Current:'));
            });
        });
    });
});

const { test } = require('node:test');
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const assert = require('assert');
const path = require('path');
const StatusView = require('../src/status/status_view');

function spawnCLI(workspacePath, botDirectory) {
    const cliScript = path.join(__dirname, '../src/cli/cli_main.py');
    const env = {
        ...process.env,
        PYTHONPATH: path.join(__dirname, '../../..'),
        BOT_DIRECTORY: botDirectory,
        WORKING_AREA: workspacePath
    };
    
    const pythonProcess = spawn('python', [cliScript], {
        cwd: workspacePath,
        env: env,
        stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe']
    });
    
    return pythonProcess;
}

function sendCommand(process, command) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        let buffer = '';
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new Error('Timeout waiting for JSON response'));
        }, 5000);
        
        process.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
            buffer += data.toString();
            try {
                const jsonData = JSON.parse(buffer.trim());
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                resolve(jsonData);
            } catch (e) {
                // Incomplete JSON, keep buffering
            }
        });
        
        process.stderr.on('data', (data) => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            reject(new Error(`Python error: ${data.toString()}`));
        });
        
        process.stdin.write(command + '\n');
    });
}

test('TestDisplayBotHierarchyTree', { concurrency: false }, async (t) => {
    
    await t.test('test_user_views_bot_hierarchy_with_status_command', async () => {
        const tmpPath = path.join(__dirname, '../../demo/mob_minion');
        const botDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../bots/base_bot');
        
        const pythonProcess = spawnCLI(tmpPath, botDir);
        
        try {
            const statusJSON = await sendCommand(pythonProcess, 'status');
            
            const statusView = new StatusView(statusJSON, null);
            const html = statusView.render();
            
            assert(statusJSON.progress_path);
            assert(statusJSON.stage_name);
            assert(html.includes(statusJSON.progress_path));
            assert(html.includes(statusJSON.stage_name));
        } finally {
            pythonProcess.kill();
        }
    });
});

```python
import pytest
import sys
import json
from agile_bot.src.cli.cli_session import CLISession
from agile_bot.bots.base_bot.test.test_invoke_bot_helpers import (
    setup_test_bot,
    create_behavior_action_state,
)


class TestDisplayBotHierarchyTree:
    
    def test_user_views_bot_hierarchy_with_status_command(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: True)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape', 'exploration'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        cli_output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        assert cli_output is not None
        assert isinstance(cli_output, str)
        assert len(cli_output) > 0
        assert not cli_output.strip().startswith('{')
    
    def test_cli_outputs_json_for_bot_hierarchy(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: False)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape', 'exploration'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        json_output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        status_json = json.loads(json_output)
        assert 'progress_path' in status_json
        assert status_json['progress_path'] == 'exploration.validate'
        assert 'current_behavior' in status_json
        assert status_json['current_behavior'] == 'exploration'
        assert 'current_action' in status_json
        assert status_json['current_action'] == 'validate'
        assert 'has_current_behavior' in status_json
        assert status_json['has_current_behavior'] is True
        assert 'has_current_action' in status_json
        assert status_json['has_current_action'] is True
    
    def test_status_markdown_displays_bot_hierarchy(self, tmp_path):
        from agile_bot.src.status.status import Status
        from agile_bot.src.status.markdown_status import MarkdownStatus
        
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape', 'exploration'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        status = bot.status()
        markdown_adapter = MarkdownStatus(status)
        markdown_output = markdown_adapter.serialize()
        
        assert '## Status' in markdown_output
        assert '**Progress Path**' in markdown_output
        assert 'exploration.validate' in markdown_output

```python
import pytest
import sys
import json
from agile_bot.src.cli.cli_session import CLISession
from agile_bot.bots.base_bot.test.test_invoke_bot_helpers import (
    setup_test_bot,
    create_behavior_action_state,
)


def _setup_bot_at_state(tmp_path, behaviors, bot_name, behavior, action):
    bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, behaviors)
    create_behavior_action_state(workspace, bot_name, behavior, action)
    bot.behaviors.load_state()
    return bot, workspace


def _get_cli_output_tty(bot, workspace, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: True)
    cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
    return cli_session.execute_command('status')


def _get_cli_output_json(bot, workspace, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: False)
    cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
    json_output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
    return json.loads(json_output)


def _get_markdown_output(bot):
    from agile_bot.src.status.markdown_status import MarkdownStatus
    status = bot.status()
    markdown_adapter = MarkdownStatus(status)
    return markdown_adapter.serialize()


def _assert_tty_output(cli_output):
    assert cli_output is not None
    assert isinstance(cli_output, str)
    assert len(cli_output) > 0
    assert not cli_output.strip().startswith('{')


def _assert_json_status(status_json, expected_behavior, expected_action):
    assert 'progress_path' in status_json
    assert status_json['progress_path'] == f'{expected_behavior}.{expected_action}'
    assert 'current_behavior' in status_json
    assert status_json['current_behavior'] == expected_behavior
    assert 'current_action' in status_json
    assert status_json['current_action'] == expected_action
    assert 'has_current_behavior' in status_json
    assert status_json['has_current_behavior'] is True
    assert 'has_current_action' in status_json
    assert status_json['has_current_action'] is True


def _assert_markdown_status(markdown_output, expected_progress_path):
    assert '## Status' in markdown_output
    assert '**Progress Path**' in markdown_output
    assert expected_progress_path in markdown_output


class TestDisplayBotHierarchyTree:
    
    def test_user_views_bot_hierarchy_with_status_command(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        bot, workspace = _setup_bot_at_state(tmp_path, ['shape', 'exploration'], 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        cli_output = _get_cli_output_tty(bot, workspace, monkeypatch)
        _assert_tty_output(cli_output)
    
    def test_user_views_bot_hierarchy_with_status_command_json(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        bot, workspace = _setup_bot_at_state(tmp_path, ['shape', 'exploration'], 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        status_json = _get_cli_output_json(bot, workspace, monkeypatch)
        _assert_json_status(status_json, 'exploration', 'validate')
    
    def test_user_views_bot_hierarchy_with_status_command_markdown(self, tmp_path):
        bot, workspace = _setup_bot_at_state(tmp_path, ['shape', 'exploration'], 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        markdown_output = _get_markdown_output(bot)
        _assert_markdown_status(markdown_output, 'exploration.validate')


class TestDisplayCurrentPosition:
    
    def test_user_views_current_position_in_status(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        bot, workspace = _setup_bot_at_state(tmp_path, ['shape'], 'story_bot', 'shape', 'clarify')
        cli_output = _get_cli_output_tty(bot, workspace, monkeypatch)
        _assert_tty_output(cli_output)
    
    def test_status_contains_progress_section_with_current_position_json(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        bot, workspace = _setup_bot_at_state(tmp_path, ['exploration'], 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        status_json = _get_cli_output_json(bot, workspace, monkeypatch)
        _assert_json_status(status_json, 'exploration', 'validate')
    
    def test_status_contains_behavior_in_progress_section_json(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        bot, workspace = _setup_bot_at_state(tmp_path, ['shape'], 'story_bot', 'shape', 'validate')
        status_json = _get_cli_output_json(bot, workspace, monkeypatch)
        assert 'current_behavior' in status_json
        assert status_json['current_behavior'] == 'shape'
        assert 'current_action' in status_json
        assert status_json['current_action'] == 'validate'
    
    def test_user_views_current_position_in_status_markdown(self, tmp_path):
        bot, workspace = _setup_bot_at_state(tmp_path, ['shape'], 'story_bot', 'shape', 'clarify')
        markdown_output = _get_markdown_output(bot)
        _assert_markdown_status(markdown_output, 'shape.clarify')
        assert '**Stage**' in markdown_output
    
    def test_status_contains_progress_section_with_current_position_markdown(self, tmp_path):
        bot, workspace = _setup_bot_at_state(tmp_path, ['exploration'], 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        markdown_output = _get_markdown_output(bot)
        assert 'exploration.validate' in markdown_output
        assert 'exploration' in markdown_output
        assert 'validate' in markdown_output

```


Refactored the tests to use reusable helper methods:

- `_setup_bot_at_state()` - Sets up bot and workspace with specified state
- `_get_cli_output_tty()` - Gets TTY output from CLI
- `_get_cli_output_json()` - Gets JSON output from CLI (parsed)
- `_get_markdown_output()` - Gets Markdown output via adapter
- `_assert_tty_output()` - Asserts TTY format
- `_assert_json_status()` - Asserts JSON status fields
- `_assert_markdown_status()` - Asserts Markdown format

Tests now focus on the scenario, with channel-specific logic in helpers. Checking for linting errors:



Refactoring complete. Tests are cleaner and follow DRY. Each test method is now 2–3 lines that call the helper methods, making the scenarios clear while channel-specific logic (TTY/JSON/Markdown) is abstracted into reusable helpers.

import pytest
import json
from pathlib import Path
from agile_bot.bots.base_bot.src.bot.bot import Bot
from agile_bot.src.status.status import Status
from agile_bot.bots.base_bot.test.test_invoke_bot_helpers import (
    setup_test_bot,
    create_behavior_action_state
)


class TestDisplayBotHierarchyTree:
    
    def test_user_views_bot_hierarchy_with_status_command(self, tmp_path):
        """
        SCENARIO: User views bot hierarchy with status command
        GIVEN: Bot is at exploration.validate
        WHEN: bot.status() is called directly
        THEN: Returns Status instance with correct progress_path and current position
        """
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape', 'exploration'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        status = bot.status()
        
        assert isinstance(status, Status)
        assert status.progress_path == "exploration.validate"
        assert status.current_behavior == "exploration"
        assert status.current_action == "validate"
        assert status.has_current_behavior is True
        assert status.has_current_action is True


class TestDisplayCurrentPosition:
    
    def test_user_views_current_position_in_status(self, tmp_path):
        """
        SCENARIO: User views current position in status
        GIVEN: Bot is at shape.clarify
        WHEN: bot.status() is called directly
        THEN: Status contains current position (shape.clarify)
        """
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'shape', 'clarify')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        status = bot.status()
        
        assert isinstance(status, Status)
        assert status.progress_path == "shape.clarify"
        assert status.current_behavior == "shape"
        assert status.current_action == "clarify"
        assert len(status.progress_path) > 0
    
    def test_status_contains_progress_section_with_current_position(self, tmp_path):
        """
        SCENARIO: Status contains Progress section with current position
        GIVEN: Bot is at exploration.validate
        WHEN: bot.status() is called directly
        THEN: Status contains progress_path and current position
        """
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['exploration'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'exploration', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        status = bot.status()
        
        assert isinstance(status, Status)
        assert status.progress_path == "exploration.validate"
        assert status.stage_name in ["In Progress", "Ready", "Idle"]
        assert status.current_behavior == "exploration"
        assert status.current_action == "validate"
    
    def test_status_contains_behavior_in_progress_section(self, tmp_path):
        """
        SCENARIO: Status contains behavior in Progress section
        GIVEN: Bot is at shape.validate
        WHEN: bot.status() is called directly
        THEN: Status contains current behavior in progress_path
        """
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape'])
        create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'shape', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        status = bot.status()
        
        assert isinstance(status, Status)
        assert status.progress_path == "shape.validate"
        assert status.current_behavior == "shape"
        assert status.current_action == "validate"
        assert "shape" in status.progress_path

const { test } = require('node:test');
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const assert = require('assert');
const path = require('path');
const StatusView = require('../src/status/status_view');

function spawnCLI(workspacePath, botDirectory) {
    const cliScript = path.join(__dirname, '../src/cli/cli_main.py');
    const env = {
        ...process.env,
        PYTHONPATH: path.join(__dirname, '../../..'),
        BOT_DIRECTORY: botDirectory,
        WORKING_AREA: workspacePath
    };
    
    const pythonProcess = spawn('python', [cliScript], {
        cwd: workspacePath,
        env: env,
        stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe']
    });
    
    return pythonProcess;
}

function sendCommand(process, command) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        let buffer = '';
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new Error('Timeout waiting for JSON response'));
        }, 5000);
        
        process.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
            buffer += data.toString();
            try {
                const jsonData = JSON.parse(buffer.trim());
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                resolve(jsonData);
            } catch (e) {
                // Incomplete JSON, keep buffering
            }
        });
        
        process.stderr.on('data', (data) => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            reject(new Error(`Python error: ${data.toString()}`));
        });
        
        process.stdin.write(command + '\n');
    });
}

test('TestDisplayBotHierarchyTree', { concurrency: false }, async (t) => {
    
    await t.test('test_user_views_bot_hierarchy_with_status_command', async () => {
        /**
         * SCENARIO: Panel displays bot hierarchy
         * GIVEN: Bot is at exploration.validate
         * WHEN: Panel refreshes and receives status JSON from CLI
         * THEN: StatusView renders bot hierarchy information
         */
        const tmpPath = path.join(__dirname, '../../demo/mob_minion');
        const botDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../bots/base_bot');
        
        const pythonProcess = spawnCLI(tmpPath, botDir);
        
        try {
            const statusJSON = await sendCommand(pythonProcess, 'status');
            
            const statusView = new StatusView(statusJSON, null);
            const html = statusView.render();
            
            assert(statusJSON.progress_path);
            assert(statusJSON.stage_name);
            assert(html.includes(statusJSON.progress_path));
            assert(html.includes(statusJSON.stage_name));
        } finally {
            pythonProcess.kill();
        }
    });
});

**User**

How do the HTML/view panel work? Is it because these are objects that you can instantiate them without a node server, and they can respond?

---

**Cursor**


Checking how the panel views work:



Checking how these views are used in the VS Code extension:



Here’s how the panel architecture works:

## Two JavaScript Environments

### 1. **VS Code Extension Host (Node.js)**
- Runs in the VS Code extension host process
- Can spawn Python subprocesses (via `child_process.spawn`)
- Has access to VS Code APIs
- This is where `StatusPanel` runs

### 2. **Webview (Browser-like sandbox)**
- The HTML panel users see
- Runs in a sandboxed browser environment
- Cannot spawn processes or use Node.js APIs directly
- Can only communicate with the extension host via `postMessage`

## Current Architecture

Looking at `status_panel.js`:

```415:478:agile_bot/bots/base_bot/src/display_panel/extension/status_panel.js
  async _update() {
    const webview = this._panel.webview;
    this._panel.title = "Bot Status Dashboard";
    
    this._logger.log("_update() called");
    
    try {
      // Check availability first
      const isAvailable = await this._dataProvider.checkAvailability();
      this._logger.log("Availability check", { isAvailable });
      
      if (!isAvailable) {
        this._panel.webview.html = this._renderer.renderError(
          "REPL CLI not found or Python not available. Please ensure Python is installed and REPL CLI is in the expected location."
        );
        return;
      }

      // Fetch status data
      const rawStatus = await this._dataProvider.getStatus();
      this._logger.log("Got raw status, length:", rawStatus.length);
      
      // Store raw status for raw instructions display
      this._rawStatusOutput = rawStatus;
      
      // Adapt CLI output to structured JSON
      const structuredData = this._adapter.adapt(rawStatus);
      
      // Add bot selector data
      structuredData.availableBots = this._dataProvider.getAvailableBots();
      structuredData.currentBot = this._dataProvider.getCurrentBot();
      
      // Get promptContent from _lastPromptContent (populated when user runs instructions)
      // If empty, try to get it now by running instructions command
      if (!this._lastPromptContent) {
        try {
          const instructionsOutput = await this._dataProvider.executeCommand('instructions');
          if (instructionsOutput && instructionsOutput.length > 100) {
            this._lastPromptContent = instructionsOutput;
            this._logger.log('Auto-fetched instructions, length:', instructionsOutput.length);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          this._logger.log('Could not auto-fetch instructions:', error.message);
        }
      }
      
      structuredData.promptContent = this._lastPromptContent || '';
      
      // Add expansion state so user's open/close choices survive re-render
      structuredData.expansionState = this._expansionState;
      
      this._logger.log("Adapted data", structuredData);

      // Render HTML (pass webview and extensionUri so renderer can create proper URIs)
      this._panel.webview.html = this._renderer.render(structuredData, this._panel.webview, this._extensionUri);
      this._logger.log("Rendered HTML to webview");
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Status panel update error:", err);
      this._logger.error("Status panel update error", err);
      this._panel.webview.html = this._renderer.renderError(err.message);
    }
  }
```

Flow:
1. Extension host spawns Python CLI and gets JSON
2. Extension host renders HTML (via `HtmlRenderer`)
3. Extension host sets `webview.html` with the rendered HTML
4. Webview displays the HTML (no Node.js APIs)

## About `PanelView` and `StatusView`

The `PanelView` and `StatusView` classes we created:

```8:108:agile_bot/src/panel/panel_view.js
class PanelView {
    /**
     * Base class for all panel views.
     * Handles subprocess communication and JSON parsing.
     */
    constructor(cli) {
        this.cli = cli;
        this.pythonProcess = null;
    }
    
    /**
     * Spawn Python CLI subprocess.
     * 
     * @param {string} scriptPath - Path to Python CLI script
     * @returns {ChildProcess} Python subprocess
     */
    spawnCLI(scriptPath) {
        this.pythonProcess = spawn('python', [scriptPath]);
        return this.pythonProcess;
    }
    
    /**
     * Send command to CLI via stdin.
     * 
     * @param {string} command - Command to send
     */
    sendCommand(command) {
        if (!this.pythonProcess) {
            throw new Error('Python process not spawned');
        }
        const commandJSON = JSON.stringify({ command: command });
        this.pythonProcess.stdin.write(commandJSON + '\n');
    }
    
    /**
     * Receive and parse JSON from CLI stdout.
     * 
     * @returns {Promise<Object>} Parsed JSON data
     */
    async receiveJSON() {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            let buffer = '';
            
            this.pythonProcess.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
                buffer += data.toString();
                
                // Try to parse complete JSON
                try {
                    const jsonData = JSON.parse(buffer);
                    resolve(jsonData);
                    buffer = ''; // Clear buffer after successful parse
                } catch (e) {
                    // Incomplete JSON, keep buffering
                }
            });
            
            this.pythonProcess.stderr.on('data', (data) => {
                reject(new Error(`Python error: ${data.toString()}`));
            });
            
            // Timeout after 5 seconds
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (buffer) {
                    reject(new Error('Timeout waiting for complete JSON response'));
                }
            }, 5000);
        });
    }
    
    /**
     * Execute command and return parsed JSON.
     * 
     * @param {string} command - Command to execute
     * @returns {Promise<Object>} Parsed JSON response
     */
    async execute(command) {
        this.sendCommand(command);
        return await this.receiveJSON();
    }
    
    /**
     * Get unique element ID for this view.
     * 
     * @returns {string} Unique element ID
     */
    getElementId() {
        return `view-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
    }
    
    /**
     * Render to HTML. Override in subclasses.
     * 
     * @param {Object} jsonData - JSON data to render
     * @returns {string} HTML string
     */
    render(jsonData) {
        throw new Error('render() must be implemented by subclass');
    }
}
```

These are Node.js classes that:
- Can be instantiated in Node.js (tests, extension host)
- Can spawn Python processes (Node.js APIs)
- Cannot run directly in the webview (webviews can’t spawn processes)

## Answer

Yes, these are objects you can instantiate without a Node server, but only in Node.js environments (tests, extension host). They cannot run directly in the webview because webviews can’t spawn processes.

For the refactored architecture:
- Tests: Use `StatusView` directly (spawn CLI, get JSON, render HTML)
- Extension host: Could use `StatusView` to render HTML, then set `webview.html`
- Webview: Cannot use `StatusView` directly; it only receives pre-rendered HTML

The current implementation uses a different pattern (`StatusDataProvider` + `HtmlRenderer`), but the new `StatusView` pattern aligns with the CRC model and can be used in tests and potentially in the extension host.

```javascript
  async _update() {
    const webview = this._panel.webview;
    this._panel.title = "Bot Status Dashboard";
    
    this._logger.log("_update() called");
    
    try {
      // Check availability first
      const isAvailable = await this._dataProvider.checkAvailability();
      this._logger.log("Availability check", { isAvailable });
      
      if (!isAvailable) {
        this._panel.webview.html = this._renderer.renderError(
          "REPL CLI not found or Python not available. Please ensure Python is installed and REPL CLI is in the expected location."
        );
        return;
      }

      // Fetch status data
      const rawStatus = await this._dataProvider.getStatus();
      this._logger.log("Got raw status, length:", rawStatus.length);
      
      // Store raw status for raw instructions display
      this._rawStatusOutput = rawStatus;
      
      // Adapt CLI output to structured JSON
      const structuredData = this._adapter.adapt(rawStatus);
      
      // Add bot selector data
      structuredData.availableBots = this._dataProvider.getAvailableBots();
      structuredData.currentBot = this._dataProvider.getCurrentBot();
      
      // Get promptContent from _lastPromptContent (populated when user runs instructions)
      // If empty, try to get it now by running instructions command
      if (!this._lastPromptContent) {
        try {
          const instructionsOutput = await this._dataProvider.executeCommand('instructions');
          if (instructionsOutput && instructionsOutput.length > 100) {
            this._lastPromptContent = instructionsOutput;
            this._logger.log('Auto-fetched instructions, length:', instructionsOutput.length);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          this._logger.log('Could not auto-fetch instructions:', error.message);
        }
      }
      
      structuredData.promptContent = this._lastPromptContent || '';
      
      // Add expansion state so user's open/close choices survive re-render
      structuredData.expansionState = this._expansionState;
      
      this._logger.log("Adapted data", structuredData);

      // Render HTML (pass webview and extensionUri so renderer can create proper URIs)
      this._panel.webview.html = this._renderer.render(structuredData, this._panel.webview, this._extensionUri);
      this._logger.log("Rendered HTML to webview");
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Status panel update error:", err);
      this._logger.error("Status panel update error", err);
      this._panel.webview.html = this._renderer.renderError(err.message);
    }
  }
```

Yes. The extension host runs in Node.js, so it can use `PanelView` and `StatusView`. Checking the current extension structure to see how to integrate them:



Yes. The extension host runs in Node.js, so it can use `PanelView` and `StatusView`. Here's how to integrate them:

## Current Extension Architecture

The extension currently uses:
1. `StatusDataProvider` - spawns Python CLI, gets text output
2. `CLIOutputAdapter` - adapts text to structured JSON  
3. `HtmlRenderer` - renders HTML from structured JSON
4. `StatusPanel` - orchestrates everything

## Refactored Architecture with `StatusView`

You can replace steps 1-3 with `StatusView`:

```javascript
// In StatusPanel._update()
async _update() {
    const webview = this._panel.webview;
    
    try {
        // Use StatusView to handle everything
        const statusView = new StatusView(null, null);
        
        // Spawn CLI and get JSON directly
        const cliScript = path.join(this._workspaceRoot, 'agile_bot/src/cli/cli_main.py');
        statusView.spawnCLI(cliScript);
        
        // Execute 'status' command and get JSON
        const statusJSON = await statusView.execute('status');
        
        // Render HTML directly
        const html = statusView.render(statusJSON);
        
        // Set HTML on webview
        this._panel.webview.html = html;
        
    } catch (err) {
        // Error handling
    }
}
```

## Benefits

1. Single responsibility: `StatusView` handles status rendering
2. Aligns with CRC model: domain views render domain objects
3. Reusable: same class used in tests and extension
4. Simpler: removes `StatusDataProvider`, `CLIOutputAdapter`, and `HtmlRenderer`
5. Type-safe: direct JSON → HTML, no intermediate text parsing

## Integration Points

The extension would:
- Import `StatusView` from `agile_bot/src/status/status_view.js`
- Use `StatusView` in `StatusPanel._update()` to get JSON and render HTML
- Keep `StatusPanel` for webview lifecycle management (create/show/dispose)
- Handle webview messages (refresh, scope updates, etc.) by calling `StatusView` methods

This matches the CRC refactoring plan: domain views handle their own rendering, and the extension orchestrates the webview.

        // Render HTML directly
        const html = statusView.render(statusJSON);
        
        // Set HTML on webview
        this._panel.webview.html = html;
        
    } catch (err) {
        // Error handling
    }
}

        () => {

**`bot_panel.js`** - Panel controller (follows `StatusView` pattern):
```javascript
const vscode = require('vscode');
const path = require('path');
const StatusView = require('../src/status/status_view');

class BotPanel {
    static currentPanel = undefined;
    static viewType = 'botpanel.statusPanel';

    constructor(panel, workspaceRoot, extensionUri) {
        this._panel = panel;
        this._workspaceRoot = workspaceRoot;
        this._extensionUri = extensionUri;
        this._disposables = [];
        
        this._update();
        this._panel.onDidDispose(() => this.dispose(), null, this._disposables);
    }

    static createOrShow(workspaceRoot, extensionUri) {
        const column = vscode.ViewColumn.Two;
        
        if (BotPanel.currentPanel) {
            BotPanel.currentPanel._panel.reveal(column);
            return;
        }

        const panel = vscode.window.createWebviewPanel(
            BotPanel.viewType,
            'Bot Status',
            column,
            {
                enableScripts: true,
                retainContextWhenHidden: false,
                localResourceRoots: [extensionUri]
            }
        );

        BotPanel.currentPanel = new BotPanel(panel, workspaceRoot, extensionUri);
    }

    async _update() {
        try {
            // Use StatusView to get JSON and render HTML
            const statusView = new StatusView(null, null);
            const cliScript = path.join(this._workspaceRoot, 'agile_bot/src/cli/cli_main.py');
            
            statusView.spawnCLI(cliScript);
            const statusJSON = await statusView.execute('status');
            
            // Render complete HTML document
            const html = this._wrapHTML(statusView.render());
            
            this._panel.webview.html = html;
        } catch (err) {
            this._panel.webview.html = this._renderError(err.message);
        }
    }

    _wrapHTML(bodyHTML) {
        return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <style>${this._getStyles()}</style>
</head>
<body>${bodyHTML}</body>
</html>`;
    }

    _getStyles() {
        return `
            body { font-family: var(--vscode-font-family); }
            .status-view { padding: 10px; }
            .status-progress, .status-stage, .status-current {
                margin: 8px 0;
            }
            .label { font-weight: bold; margin-right: 8px; }
        `;
    }

    _renderError(message) {
        return `<!DOCTYPE html><html><body><p>Error: ${message}</p></body></html>`;
    }

    dispose() {
        BotPanel.currentPanel = undefined;
        this._panel.dispose();
        while (this._disposables.length) {
            this._disposables.pop().dispose();
        }
    }
}

module.exports = BotPanel;
```

├── bot_panel.js           # 🆕 Panel controller (uses StatusView)
├── extension.js           # 🆕 VS Code extension entry point  
├── package.json           # 🆕 Extension manifest
├── img/                   # 🆕 Images folder
└── rebuild.ps1            # 🆕 Build script (optional)
```

## Why This Makes Sense

1. Co-location: The extension uses `PanelView` and `StatusView`, so it belongs with them.
2. Clear namespace: `src/panel/` contains everything panel-related.
3. Simpler imports: `bot_panel.js` can import `../status/status_view` directly.
4. Consistent with domain structure: Similar to how `src/status/` has the status domain.

## What Goes Where

**`src/panel/extension.js`** - Main entry point:
```javascript
const vscode = require('vscode');
const BotPanel = require('./bot_panel');

function activate(context) {
    const showStatusCommand = vscode.commands.registerCommand(
        'botpanel.showStatus',
        () => {
            const workspaceRoot = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders?.[0]?.uri.fsPath;
            if (workspaceRoot) {
                BotPanel.createOrShow(workspaceRoot, context.extensionUri);
            }
        }
    );
    context.subscriptions.push(showStatusCommand);
}

module.exports = { activate, deactivate: () => {} };
```

**`src/panel/bot_panel.js`** - Uses `StatusView`:
```javascript
const vscode = require('vscode');
const path = require('path');
const StatusView = require('../status/status_view');

class BotPanel {
    // ... (same as before, but imports from ../status/status_view)
}
```

**`src/panel/package.json`** - Extension manifest (same as before, just different location)

This keeps everything panel-related in one place. The extension is just another way to use the panel views.

test('TestStartPanel', { concurrency: false }, async (t) => {
    
    await t.test('test_panel_opens_in_json_mode', async () => {
        /**
         * SCENARIO: Panel opens in JSON mode
         * GIVEN: Panel spawns CLI subprocess (piped mode)
         * WHEN: Panel sends 'status' command to CLI
         * THEN: CLI returns JSON response
         * AND: StatusView can parse JSON and render HTML
         */
        // Spawn CLI, get JSON, verify StatusView can render
    });
    
    await t.test('test_panel_displays_status_correctly', async () => {
        /**
         * SCENARIO: Panel displays status correctly
         * GIVEN: Bot is at exploration.validate
         * WHEN: Panel opens and receives status JSON from CLI
         * THEN: StatusView renders bot hierarchy information
         * AND: StatusView renders current position
         * AND: StatusView renders all required sections
         */
        // Similar to test_panel_status.js but for "Open Panel" story
    });
    
    await t.test('test_panel_already_open_when_command_executed', async () => {
        /**
         * SCENARIO: Panel already open when command executed
         * GIVEN: Panel is already open
         * WHEN: User executes panel command again
         * THEN: Existing panel is refreshed (not duplicated)
         */
        // Test that StatusView can be re-instantiated with new JSON
    });
    
    await t.test('test_panel_handles_cli_errors_gracefully', async () => {
        /**

         * GIVEN: CLI subprocess fails or returns invalid JSON

         * AND: Panel does not crash

    });
});

import pytest
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from agile_bot.src.cli.cli_session import CLISession
from agile_bot.bots.base_bot.test.test_invoke_bot_helpers import (
    setup_test_bot,
    create_behavior_action_state
)


def create_story_graph(workspace_directory):
    stories_dir = workspace_directory / 'docs' / 'stories'
    stories_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    story_graph = {
        "epics": [
            {
                "name": "Test Epic",
                "stories": ["Test Story 1", "Test Story 2"]
            }
        ]
    }
    (stories_dir / 'story-graph.json').write_text(json.dumps(story_graph))
    return stories_dir / 'story-graph.json'


class TestStartCLISession:
    
    def test_cli_launches_in_tty_mode(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """
        SCENARIO: CLI launches in TTY mode (interactive terminal)
        GIVEN: CLISession detects TTY terminal
        WHEN: CLI initializes and executes status command
        THEN: CLISession selects TTYAdapter
        AND: CLI outputs TTY format
        """
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: True)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape'])
        
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        
        assert cli_session.bot is not None
        assert cli_session.bot.bot_name == 'story_bot'
        
        output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        assert output is not None
        assert len(output) > 0
    
    def test_cli_launches_in_json_mode(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """
        SCENARIO: CLI launches in JSON mode (piped subprocess)
        GIVEN: CLISession detects piped input (non-TTY)
        WHEN: CLI initializes and executes status command
        THEN: CLISession selects JSONAdapter
        AND: CLI outputs JSON format
        """
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: False)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape'])
        
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        
        assert cli_session.bot is not None
        
        output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        assert output is not None
        status_json = json.loads(output)
        assert 'progress_path' in status_json or 'stage_name' in status_json
    
    def test_cli_loads_existing_behavior_action_state_on_launch(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """
        SCENARIO: CLI loads existing behavior action state on launch
        GIVEN: Behavior action state file exists
        WHEN: CLI initializes and executes status command
        THEN: CLI returns status reflecting loaded state
        """
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: False)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['discovery'])
        state_file = create_behavior_action_state(workspace, 'story_bot', 'discovery', 'validate')
        bot.behaviors.load_state()
        
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        
        assert state_file.exists()
        
        output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        status_json = json.loads(output)
        
        assert status_json.get('current_behavior') == 'discovery'
        assert status_json.get('current_action') == 'validate'


class TestDisplayPipedModeInstructionsForAIAgents:
    
    def test_cli_displays_piped_mode_instructions_in_pipe_mode(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """
        SCENARIO: CLI displays piped mode instructions in pipe mode
        GIVEN: CLISession detects piped input
        WHEN: CLI initializes
        THEN: CLI outputs JSON format suitable for AI agents
        """
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: False)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape'])
        
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        status_json = json.loads(output)
        assert isinstance(status_json, dict)
    
    def test_cli_omits_piped_mode_instructions_in_interactive_mode(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """
        SCENARIO: CLI omits piped mode instructions in interactive mode
        GIVEN: CLISession detects interactive TTY
        WHEN: CLI initializes
        THEN: CLI outputs TTY format (not JSON)
        """
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys.stdout, 'isatty', lambda: True)
        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape'])
        
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        output = cli_session.execute_command('status')
        
        assert output is not None
        try:
            json.loads(output)
            assert False, "Should not output JSON in TTY mode"
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass


class TestDetectAndConfigureTTYNonTTYInput:
    
    def test_tty_detector_identifies_interactive_terminal(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """

        GIVEN: stdout is connected to a TTY terminal
        WHEN: CLISession executes command
        THEN: CLISession selects TTYAdapter
        """

        bot, workspace = setup_test_bot(tmp_path, ['shape'])
        
        cli_session = CLISession(bot=bot, workspace_directory=workspace)
        output = cli_session.execute_command('status')

    def test_tty_detector_identifies_piped_input(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        """

        GIVEN: stdout is piped from another process

```javascript
const { test } = require('node:test');
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const assert = require('assert');
const path = require('path');
const StatusView = require('../src/status/status_view');

function spawnCLI(workspacePath, botDirectory) {
    const cliScript = path.join(__dirname, '../src/cli/cli_main.py');
    const env = {
        ...process.env,
        PYTHONPATH: path.join(__dirname, '../../..'),
        BOT_DIRECTORY: botDirectory,
        WORKING_AREA: workspacePath
    };
    
    const pythonProcess = spawn('python', [cliScript], {
        cwd: workspacePath,
        env: env,
        stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe']
    });
    
    return pythonProcess;
}

function sendCommand(process, command) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        let buffer = '';
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new Error('Timeout waiting for JSON response'));
        }, 5000);
        
        process.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
            buffer += data.toString();
            try {
                const jsonData = JSON.parse(buffer.trim());
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                resolve(jsonData);
            } catch (e) {
            }
        });
        
        process.stderr.on('data', (data) => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            reject(new Error(`Python error: ${data.toString()}`));
        });
        
        process.stdin.write(command + '\n');
    });
}

test('TestStartPanel', { concurrency: false }, async (t) => {
    
    await t.test('test_panel_opens_in_json_mode', async () => {
        /**
         * SCENARIO: Panel opens in JSON mode
         * GIVEN: Panel spawns CLI subprocess (piped mode)
         * WHEN: Panel sends 'status' command to CLI
         * THEN: CLI returns JSON response
         * AND: StatusView can parse JSON and render HTML
         */
        const tmpPath = path.join(__dirname, '../../demo/mob_minion');
        const botDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../bots/base_bot');
        
        const pythonProcess = spawnCLI(tmpPath, botDir);
        
        try {
            const statusJSON = await sendCommand(pythonProcess, 'status');
            
            assert(typeof statusJSON === 'object');
            assert('progress_path' in statusJSON || 'stage_name' in statusJSON);
            
            const statusView = new StatusView(statusJSON, null);
            const html = statusView.render();
            
            assert(typeof html === 'string');
            assert(html.length > 0);
        } finally {
            pythonProcess.kill();
        }
    });
    
    await t.test('test_panel_displays_status_correctly', async () => {
        /**
         * SCENARIO: Panel displays status correctly
         * GIVEN: Bot is at exploration.validate
         * WHEN: Panel opens and receives status JSON from CLI
         * THEN: StatusView renders bot hierarchy information
         * AND: StatusView renders current position
         */
        const tmpPath = path.join(__dirname, '../../demo/mob_minion');
        const botDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../bots/base_bot');
        
        const pythonProcess = spawnCLI(tmpPath, botDir);
        
        try {
            const statusJSON = await sendCommand(pythonProcess, 'status');
            
            assert(statusJSON.progress_path);
            assert(statusJSON.stage_name);
            
            const statusView = new StatusView(statusJSON, null);
            const html = statusView.render();
            
            assert(html.includes(statusJSON.progress_path));
            assert(html.includes(statusJSON.stage_name));
            
            if (statusJSON.current_behavior) {
                assert(html.includes(statusJSON.current_behavior));
            }
        } finally {
            pythonProcess.kill();
        }
    });
    
    await t.test('test_panel_already_open_when_command_executed', async () => {
        /**
         * SCENARIO: Panel already open when command executed
         * GIVEN: Panel is already open
         * WHEN: User executes panel command again (sends another status command)
         * THEN: Existing panel is refreshed (not duplicated)
         * AND: StatusView can be re-instantiated with new JSON
         */
        const tmpPath = path.join(__dirname, '../../demo/mob_minion');
        const botDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../bots/base_bot');
        
        const pythonProcess = spawnCLI(tmpPath, botDir);
        
        try {
            const statusJSON1 = await sendCommand(pythonProcess, 'status');
            const statusView1 = new StatusView(statusJSON1, null);
            const html1 = statusView1.render();
            
            const statusJSON2 = await sendCommand(pythonProcess, 'status');
            const statusView2 = new StatusView(statusJSON2, null);
            const html2 = statusView2.render();
            
            assert(typeof html1 === 'string');
            assert(typeof html2 === 'string');
            assert(html1.length > 0);
            assert(html2.length > 0);
        } finally {
            pythonProcess.kill();
        }
    });
    
    await t.test('test_panel_handles_cli_errors_gracefully', async () => {
        /**
         * SCENARIO: Panel handles CLI errors gracefully
         * GIVEN: CLI subprocess is spawned
         * WHEN: Panel sends invalid command
         * THEN: Panel receives error response
         * AND: Panel does not crash
         */
        const tmpPath = path.join(__dirname, '../../demo/mob_minion');
        const botDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../bots/base_bot');
        
        const pythonProcess = spawnCLI(tmpPath, botDir);
        
        try {
            try {
                await sendCommand(pythonProcess, 'invalid_command_xyz');
                assert.fail('Should have thrown error for invalid command');
            } catch (error) {
                assert(error instanceof Error);
            }
        } finally {
            pythonProcess.kill();
        }
    });
});

```markdown
# Bot Panel Extension - Install/Uninstall Testing Guide

## Prerequisites

1. **VS Code Extension CLI (`vsce`)**:
   ```powershell
   npm install -g @vscode/vsce
   ```

2. **Extension Files** (should be in `agile_bot/src/panel/`):
   - `package.json` - Extension manifest
   - `extension.js` - Main entry point
   - `bot_panel.js` - Panel controller
   - `img/` - Images folder (optional)

## Quick Test Workflow

### Option 1: Development Mode (Recommended for Testing)

1. **Open extension folder in VS Code**:
   ```powershell
   cd agile_bot/src/panel
   code .
   ```

2. **Press F5** to launch Extension Development Host
   - Opens a new VS Code window with your extension loaded
   - Changes reload automatically (just reload the dev window with Ctrl+R)

3. **Test the extension**:
   - Press `Ctrl+Shift+P` (or `Cmd+Shift+P` on Mac)
   - Type "View Bot Panel" or "agilebot.viewPanel"
   - Execute the command
   - Panel should open

4. **Check Debug Console** for any errors

**Pros:**
- Instant feedback
- No need to rebuild/reinstall
- Easy to debug

**Cons:**
- Only works in development host window

### Option 2: Build and Install (For Production Testing)

#### Step 1: Build Extension Package

```powershell
cd agile_bot/src/panel
npx @vscode/vsce package
```

This creates a `.vsix` file (e.g., `bot-panel-0.1.0.vsix`)

#### Step 2: Install Extension

**Method A: Install from VSIX file**
```powershell
code --install-extension bot-panel-0.1.0.vsix --force
```

**Method B: Install from command line (if using Cursor)**
```powershell
cursor --install-extension bot-panel-0.1.0.vsix --force
```

#### Step 3: Reload VS Code/Cursor

- Press `Ctrl+Shift+P` (or `Cmd+Shift+P`)
- Type "Developer: Reload Window"
- Press Enter

#### Step 4: Test Extension

- Press `Ctrl+Shift+P`
- Type "View Bot Panel" or "agilebot.viewPanel"
- Execute the command
- Panel should open

#### Step 5: Uninstall Extension

**Method A: Uninstall by ID**
```powershell
code --uninstall-extension agilebot.bot-panel
```

**Method B: Uninstall via UI**
1. Open Extensions view (`Ctrl+Shift+X`)
2. Search for "Bot Panel"
3. Click gear icon → "Uninstall"

**Method C: Uninstall via Command Palette**
1. Press `Ctrl+Shift+P`
2. Type "Extensions: Show Installed Extensions"
3. Find "Bot Panel"
4. Right-click → "Uninstall"

## Automated Build Script

Create `agile_bot/src/panel/rebuild.ps1`:

```powershell
# Rebuild and reinstall Bot Panel extension
# Usage: .\rebuild.ps1

Write-Host "Cleaning up old VSIX files..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Remove-Item *.vsix -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host "Packaging extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
npx @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository

Write-Host "Finding latest VSIX..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$vsix = Get-ChildItem -Filter *.vsix | Select-Object -First 1

if ($vsix) {
    Write-Host "Installing $($vsix.Name)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    code --install-extension $vsix.FullName --force
    
    Write-Host "`nExtension rebuilt and installed!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "Reload VS Code window to activate changes (Ctrl+R or Cmd+R)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
} else {
    Write-Host "ERROR: No VSIX file found" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
```

Then run:
```powershell
.\rebuild.ps1
```

## Testing Checklist

### Install Test
- [ ] Extension packages without errors
- [ ] VSIX file is created
- [ ] Extension installs successfully
- [ ] Extension appears in Extensions list
- [ ] Command "agilebot.viewPanel" is available
- [ ] Panel opens when command is executed
- [ ] Panel displays status correctly

### Uninstall Test
- [ ] Extension uninstalls successfully
- [ ] Extension disappears from Extensions list
- [ ] Command "agilebot.viewPanel" is no longer available
- [ ] No leftover files in extension directory

### Reinstall Test
- [ ] Can uninstall and reinstall multiple times
- [ ] Version updates work correctly
- [ ] No conflicts with previous versions

## Troubleshooting

### Extension Not Appearing
- Check `package.json` has correct `name` and `publisher`
- Verify `main` field points to correct file
- Check for syntax errors in `extension.js`
- View Output panel → "Extension Host" for errors

### Command Not Found
- Verify `contributes.commands` in `package.json`
- Check command ID matches exactly
- Reload window after install

### Panel Not Opening
- Check `bot_panel.js` is correct
- Verify CLI script path is correct
- Check Python is available
- View Debug Console (F5 mode) or Output panel for errors

### VSIX Packaging Errors
- Ensure `package.json` is valid JSON
- Check all required fields are present
- Verify `main` file exists
- Run `npx @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository` for warnings

## Extension ID Format

Your extension ID is: `{publisher}.{name}`

From `package.json`:
- `publisher`: "agilebot"
- `name`: "bot-panel"
- **Extension ID**: `agilebot.bot-panel`

Use this ID for uninstall commands:
```powershell
code --uninstall-extension agilebot.bot-panel
```

```powershell
# Rebuild and reinstall Bot Panel extension
# Usage: .\rebuild.ps1

Write-Host "Cleaning up old VSIX files..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Remove-Item *.vsix -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host "Packaging extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
npx @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "ERROR: Packaging failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

Write-Host "Finding latest VSIX..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$vsix = Get-ChildItem -Filter *.vsix | Select-Object -First 1

if ($vsix) {
    Write-Host "Uninstalling old extension (if exists)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    code --uninstall-extension agilebot.bot-panel 2>$null
    
    Write-Host "Installing $($vsix.Name)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    code --install-extension $vsix.FullName --force
    
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
        Write-Host "`nExtension rebuilt and installed!" -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "Reload VS Code window to activate changes (Ctrl+R or Cmd+R)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    } else {
        Write-Host "ERROR: Installation failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "ERROR: No VSIX file found" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

```

```powershell
# Agile Bot CLI Launcher (Windows/PowerShell)
#
# Usage (for humans):
#   .\cli_execute.ps1
#
# This launches the interactive CLI session
# Bot behaviors are loaded from configured bot directory
# Working directory defaults to workspace root
#
# AI AGENTS:
#   Commands must be PIPED via echo, NOT passed as arguments!
#   PowerShell uses semicolons (;) to chain commands, NOT && (that's bash/cmd)
#   
#   WHAT DOES NOT WORK:
#     [X] python cli_main.py instructions
#     [X] python cli_main.py --command instructions
#   
#   WHAT WORKS:
#     [OK] echo 'instructions' | python cli_main.py
#   
#   Step 1: Set environment and pipe command:
#     cd C:\dev\augmented-teams
#     $env:PYTHONPATH = "C:\dev\augmented-teams"
#     $env:BOT_DIRECTORY = "C:\dev\augmented-teams\agile_bot\bots\base_bot"
#     $env:WORKING_AREA = "<project_path>"  # e.g. demo\mob_minion
#     echo "status" | python agile_bot/src/cli/cli_main.py
#   
#   Step 2: Read output, do work (create files, etc.)
#   Step 3: Pipe next command: echo "next" | python cli_main.py
#   Step 4: Repeat for each step in workflow
#   
#   CLI exits after each command - this is NORMAL in piped mode

$SCRIPT_DIR = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$WORKSPACE_ROOT = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $SCRIPT_DIR)

# Set environment variables
$env:PYTHONPATH = $WORKSPACE_ROOT
$env:BOT_DIRECTORY = Join-Path $WORKSPACE_ROOT "agile_bot\bots\base_bot"
# WORKING_AREA is read from bot_config.json by cli_main.py - don't set it here

# Launch CLI
$CLI_PATH = Join-Path $WORKSPACE_ROOT "agile_bot/src/cli/cli_main.py"
python $CLI_PATH

```

```powershell
# Rebuild and reinstall Bot Panel extension
# Usage: .\panel_rebuild.ps1

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# Navigate to panel directory
$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$panelDir = Join-Path $scriptDir "..\panel"
Set-Location $panelDir

Write-Host "Cleaning up old VSIX files..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Remove-Item *.vsix -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host "Packaging extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
npx @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "ERROR: Packaging failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

Write-Host "Finding latest VSIX..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$vsix = Get-ChildItem -Filter *.vsix | Select-Object -First 1

if ($vsix) {
    Write-Host "Uninstalling old extension (if exists)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    code --uninstall-extension agilebot.bot-panel 2>$null
    
    Write-Host "Installing $($vsix.Name)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    code --install-extension $vsix.FullName --force
    
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
        Write-Host "`nExtension rebuilt and installed!" -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "Reload VS Code window to activate changes (Ctrl+R or Cmd+R)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    } else {
        Write-Host "ERROR: Installation failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "ERROR: No VSIX file found" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

```powershell
# Bump version, rebuild, and reinstall the Bot Panel extension
# Usage: .\panel_bump_and_install.ps1 [patch|minor|major]
# Default: patch (0.1.0 -> 0.1.1)

param(
    [ValidateSet('patch', 'minor', 'major')]
    [string]$BumpType = 'patch'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# Navigate to panel directory
$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$panelDir = Join-Path $scriptDir "..\panel"
Set-Location $panelDir

Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Bot Panel Version Bump" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

# Read current version from package.json
$packageJson = Get-Content "package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$currentVersion = $packageJson.version
Write-Host "Current version: $currentVersion" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# Parse version
$versionParts = $currentVersion -split '\.'
$major = [int]$versionParts[0]
$minor = [int]$versionParts[1]
$patch = [int]$versionParts[2]

# Bump version based on type
switch ($BumpType) {
    'major' { 
        $major++
        $minor = 0
        $patch = 0
    }
    'minor' { 
        $minor++
        $patch = 0
    }
    'patch' { 
        $patch++
    }
}

$newVersion = "$major.$minor.$patch"
Write-Host "New version:     $newVersion" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""

# Update package.json
Write-Host "[1/6] Updating package.json..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$packageJsonContent = Get-Content "package.json" -Raw

```powershell
# Agile Bot CLI Launcher (Windows/PowerShell)
#
# Usage (for humans):
#   .\cli_execute.ps1
#
# This launches the interactive CLI session
# Bot behaviors are loaded from configured bot directory
# Working directory defaults to workspace root
#
# AI AGENTS:
#   Commands must be PIPED via echo, NOT passed as arguments!
#   PowerShell uses semicolons (;) to chain commands, NOT && (that's bash/cmd)
#   
#   WHAT DOES NOT WORK:
#     [X] python cli_main.py instructions
#     [X] python cli_main.py --command instructions
#   
#   WHAT WORKS:
#     [OK] echo 'instructions' | python cli_main.py
#   
#   Step 1: Set environment and pipe command:
#     cd C:\dev\augmented-teams
#     $env:PYTHONPATH = "C:\dev\augmented-teams"
#     $env:BOT_DIRECTORY = "C:\dev\augmented-teams\agile_bot\bots\base_bot"
#     $env:WORKING_AREA = "<project_path>"  # e.g. demo\mob_minion
#     echo "status" | python agile_bot/src/cli/cli_main.py
#   
#   Step 2: Read output, do work (create files, etc.)
#   Step 3: Pipe next command: echo "next" | python cli_main.py
#   Step 4: Repeat for each step in workflow
#   
#   CLI exits after each command - this is NORMAL in piped mode

$SCRIPT_DIR = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$WORKSPACE_ROOT = Split-Path -Parent $SCRIPT_DIR

# Set environment variables
$env:PYTHONPATH = $WORKSPACE_ROOT
$env:BOT_DIRECTORY = Join-Path $WORKSPACE_ROOT "agile_bot\bots\base_bot"
# WORKING_AREA is read from bot_config.json by cli_main.py - don't set it here

# Launch CLI
$CLI_PATH = Join-Path $WORKSPACE_ROOT "agile_bot/src/cli/cli_main.py"
python $CLI_PATH

```powershell
# Rebuild and reinstall Bot Panel extension
# Usage: .\panel_rebuild.ps1

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# Navigate to panel directory
$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$panelDir = Join-Path $scriptDir "src\panel"
Set-Location $panelDir

Write-Host "Cleaning up old VSIX files..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Remove-Item *.vsix -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host "Packaging extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
npx @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "ERROR: Packaging failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

Write-Host "Finding latest VSIX..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$vsix = Get-ChildItem -Filter *.vsix | Select-Object -First 1

if ($vsix) {
    Write-Host "Uninstalling old extension (if exists)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    code --uninstall-extension agilebot.bot-panel 2>$null
    
    Write-Host "Installing $($vsix.Name)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    code --install-extension $vsix.FullName --force
    
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
        Write-Host "`nExtension rebuilt and installed!" -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "Reload VS Code window to activate changes (Ctrl+R or Cmd+R)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    } else {
        Write-Host "ERROR: Installation failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "ERROR: No VSIX file found" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

```

```powershell
# Bump version, rebuild, and reinstall the Bot Panel extension
# Usage: .\panel_bump_and_install.ps1 [patch|minor|major]
# Default: patch (0.1.0 -> 0.1.1)

param(
    [ValidateSet('patch', 'minor', 'major')]
    [string]$BumpType = 'patch'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# Navigate to panel directory
$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$panelDir = Join-Path $scriptDir "src\panel"
Set-Location $panelDir

Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Bot Panel Version Bump" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

# Read current version from package.json
$packageJson = Get-Content "package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$currentVersion = $packageJson.version
Write-Host "Current version: $currentVersion" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# Parse version
$versionParts = $currentVersion -split '\.'
$major = [int]$versionParts[0]
$minor = [int]$versionParts[1]
$patch = [int]$versionParts[2]

# Bump version based on type
switch ($BumpType) {
    'major' { 
        $major++
        $minor = 0
        $patch = 0
    }
    'minor' { 
        $minor++
        $patch = 0
    }
    'patch' { 
        $patch++
    }
}

$newVersion = "$major.$minor.$patch"
Write-Host "New version:     $newVersion" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""

# Update package.json
Write-Host "[1/6] Updating package.json..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$packageJsonContent = Get-Content "package.json" -Raw
$packageJsonContent = $packageJsonContent -replace "`"version`": `"$currentVersion`"", "`"version`": `"$newVersion`""
Set-Content "package.json" -Value $packageJsonContent -NoNewline
Write-Host "      Done: package.json updated" -ForegroundColor Green

# Package extension
Write-Host "[2/6] Packaging extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
npx @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository --allow-star-activation | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "      ERROR: Packaging failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
Write-Host "      Done: Extension packaged: bot-panel-$newVersion.vsix" -ForegroundColor Green

# Uninstall old extension
Write-Host "[3/6] Uninstalling old extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
code --uninstall-extension agilebot.bot-panel | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "      Warning: Uninstall warning (may not be installed)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
} else {
    Write-Host "      Done: Old extension uninstalled" -ForegroundColor Green
}

# Install new extension
Write-Host "[4/6] Installing new extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$vsixPath = Join-Path $panelDir "bot-panel-$newVersion.vsix"
code --install-extension "$vsixPath" | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "      ERROR: Installation failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
Write-Host "      Done: Extension v$newVersion installed" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "SUCCESS!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Extension upgraded: $currentVersion -> $newVersion" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[5/6] Please reload VS Code window manually:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "      Press Ctrl+Shift+P -> Developer: Reload Window" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Extension v$newVersion will be active after reload!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""

```powershell
# Bump version, rebuild, and reinstall the Bot Panel extension
# Usage: .\panel_bump_and_install.ps1 [patch|minor|major]
# Default: patch (0.1.0 -> 0.1.1)

param(
    [ValidateSet('patch', 'minor', 'major')]
    [string]$BumpType = 'patch'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# Navigate to panel directory using relative paths
$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$panelDir = Join-Path $scriptDir -ChildPath "src","panel"
Set-Location $panelDir

Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Bot Panel Version Bump" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

# Read current version from package.json
$packageJson = Get-Content "package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$currentVersion = $packageJson.version
Write-Host "Current version: $currentVersion" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# Parse version
$versionParts = $currentVersion -split '\.'
$major = [int]$versionParts[0]
$minor = [int]$versionParts[1]
$patch = [int]$versionParts[2]

# Bump version based on type
switch ($BumpType) {
    'major' { 
        $major++
        $minor = 0
        $patch = 0
    }
    'minor' { 
        $minor++
        $patch = 0
    }
    'patch' { 
        $patch++
    }
}

$newVersion = "$major.$minor.$patch"
Write-Host "New version:     $newVersion" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""

# Update package.json
Write-Host "[1/6] Updating package.json..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$packageJsonContent = Get-Content "package.json" -Raw
$packageJsonContent = $packageJsonContent -replace "`"version`": `"$currentVersion`"", "`"version`": `"$newVersion`""
Set-Content "package.json" -Value $packageJsonContent -NoNewline
Write-Host "      Done: package.json updated" -ForegroundColor Green

# Package extension
Write-Host "[2/6] Packaging extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
npx @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository --allow-star-activation | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "      ERROR: Packaging failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
Write-Host "      Done: Extension packaged: bot-panel-$newVersion.vsix" -ForegroundColor Green

# Uninstall old extension
Write-Host "[3/6] Uninstalling old extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
code --uninstall-extension agilebot.bot-panel | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "      Warning: Uninstall warning (may not be installed)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
} else {
    Write-Host "      Done: Old extension uninstalled" -ForegroundColor Green
}

# Install new extension
Write-Host "[4/6] Installing new extension..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$vsixPath = Join-Path $panelDir "bot-panel-$newVersion.vsix"
$vsixPath = (Resolve-Path $vsixPath).Path
code --install-extension "$vsixPath" | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "      ERROR: Installation failed!" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
Write-Host "      Done: Extension v$newVersion installed" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "SUCCESS!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Extension upgraded: $currentVersion -> $newVersion" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[5/6] Please reload VS Code window manually:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "      Press Ctrl+Shift+P -> Developer: Reload Window" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Extension v$newVersion will be active after reload!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""
